name: Catalyst Old River Hydroelectric Limited Partnership
aliases: Sidney A. Murray Jr. Hydroelectric Station
description: Catalyst Old River Hydroelectric Limited Partnership owns and operates the 192 MW Sidney A. Murray Jr. Hydroelectric Station on a diversion of the Mississippi River near Vidalia, Louisiana. The run-of-river facility entered service in 1990 and sells power to an Entergy utility and the Town of Vidalia under long-term arrangements extending through 2031. Brookfield Renewable affiliates hold the 75% economic balance and the managing/control position. ArcLight Capital Partners holds the remaining 25% through ArcLight Renewable Infrastructure Fund SM SPV, L.P., which acquired the interest from ArcLight Energy Partners Fund V on July 8, 2021. The project company is the single PortCo; its upstream holdcos, co-licensee and lenders are not separate owners.
